scope: TakeProfit strategy emulator behavior plus deterministic safety fixtures; not a live exchange execution guarantee.

order_statuses.unknown_status_policy: Fail closed: request cancellation once and keep blocking new entries until a documented terminal status is observed.

invariants: At most one active parent entry order exists.
A new candidate cannot submit while a parent order is active, a position is open, or an order resolved during the same strategy update.
A fill may arrive after a cancellation request and before its acknowledgment; the active parent remains a guard throughout that interval.
After a partial parent fill, protection quantity equals absolute open position size in the TakeProfit backtesting emulator.
A protective exit reduces exposure only and cannot cross flat or reverse the position.
Any observed reduction or closure of a position while a partial parent entry remains active requests cancellation of the parent remainder.
A fill after cancellation acknowledgment is an exchange/emulator discrepancy and is not silently accepted by the reference model.
A same-minute candle touching both stop and target remains ambiguous; stop-first is reported only as a conservative bound.
Timed exits remain disabled until a reducing-close and outstanding-entry cancellation sequence is separately verified.

observation_model.entry: The historical barrier-path sensitivity replay assumes a fill at the immutable planned next-bar-open quote. It does not infer a fill from a limit touch, queue position, or actual execution.
observation_model.lower_interval: Use aligned Binance trade 1m and mark 1m OHLC bars to determine which barrier was reached first across minutes.
observation_model.within_one_minute: If both barriers are inside the same 1m high-low range and the open did not gap through the stop, retain AMBIGUOUS and report a separate stop-first conservative bound.
observation_model.stop_gap: If a 1m open gaps beyond the stop, record the open as a hypothetical adverse gap fill; it is not an observed exchange fill.
observation_model.brackets: TakeProfit documents emulator brackets as position-level OCO orders whose quantity follows the current position. Live attached-order behavior is controlled by the selected exchange and remains unknown.
observation_model.reload: The deterministic model persists candidate IDs, order state, position, bracket state, cooldown state, and event sequence; replaying the same event suffix after restoration must produce identical outputs.

deferred: No timed or maximum-hold exit is added.
No live exchange order behavior is inferred; Binance is only a research proxy and the actual venue is unset.
No actual fill prices, queue priority, partial-fill rates, fee schedule, or slippage are inferred from OHLC data.
